name: CloseWebBrowserTab
label: Close Web Browser Tab
description: Closes web browser tabs based on various conditions (current, by title/URL, all except main, timeout-based).

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: The WebDriver instance containing browser session.

fields.name: CloseMode
fields.label: Close Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to close the tab(s): Current, By Title/URL, All Except Main, or After Timeout.

selectOptions.label: By Title or URL
selectOptions.description: Closes tab(s) whose title or URL contains the specified text.

selectOptions.label: All Except Main
selectOptions.description: Closes all tabs except the main one.

selectOptions.label: After Timeout
selectOptions.description: Closes the tab after a certain period.

fields.name: MatchType
fields.label: Match Type
fields.description: Select whether to match by URL or Title when using 'ByTitleOrUrl' mode.

fields.name: MatchCriteria
fields.label: Match Criteria
fields.description: Enter the URL or Title to match when using 'ByTitleOrUrl' mode.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds before closing the tab automatically.
